verdict: Pass for the narrow diagnostic-text migration
review_method: Read-only Git diff, exact string-only transformation, unchanged original probe bytes, and comparison with the current production diagnostic literal.
old_diagnostic_substring: one or two finite nonescaping callable roles with Copy results
new_diagnostic_substring: one or two finite nonescaping callable roles, a single lending role, or a bounded same-F owning State constructor are implemented
production_diff_basis: Reviewed commit versus its first parent, all crates/*/src plus Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock.

parent_full_run_report.ownership: Parent-reported execution, not rerun or reattributed to this reviewer.

boundary: The source remains a front-door unsupported case. The text change is not a borrow-safety proof. Original failed full-workspace records remain authoritative; targeted results cannot be summed into a full-workspace Pass.
